verdict.rationale: Docs confirm S3-compatible object storage for persisting training data, checkpoints, and model weights independent of GPU compute (coreweave-docs-10), which satisfies the 'outlives any single GPU rental' need, but there's no explicit evidence of attachable persistent block/network volumes (e.g., Kubernetes PersistentVolumes or NFS-style storage) for CKS nodes specifically surviving instance teardown. missing for 10: documentation of block/network-attached persistent volumes for CKS nodes, PVC/storage-class details, and independent confirmation of data survival across instance teardown.
